paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kiddushin 8a: Mar bar Rav Ashi bought a scarf worth ten for thirteen from the mother of Rabbah of Kuvei.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Kiddushin 8a names Rava of Kuvei, while Hyman’s heading has Rabbah. The sale direction, scarf worth ten bought for thirteen from his mother, is retained.

The whole Davidson Kiddushin 8a paragraph reads Rava of Kuvei, whereas Hyman supplies Rabbah. It has Mar bar Rav Ashi buying the scarf worth ten for thirteen from his mother. The name difference remains visible in the retained note, without harmonizing the two names.
